T038.description: Build align-fleet.sh + align-plan.py to align all fleet ExternalSecret remoteRef.key/dataFrom.extract.key to VS-004 /<env>/<service>/<key>; wire planner + orchestrator (dry-run, --apply-manifests with .bak backups, --apply-vault KV migration, --yes gate), report VS-003/VS-006 blockers never auto-fixed; add tests/align-fleet.bats + README usage
T038.result_summary: align-fleet.sh + align-plan.py built and validated end-to-end on isolated sandboxes. Planner emits line-precise TSV (FILE/LINE/KIND/OLD/PROP/TARGET/NEW/STATUS), ALIGN/CONFORM/SKIP. Blocker reporting surfaces analyst/aws VS-003 UNKNOWN stores and familytree VS-006 bcrypt. Real fleet dry-run: 20 ALIGN, 0 SKIP, 0 CONFORM, exit 1; post-apply re-run clean (0 ALIGN, exit 0). Real repos verified untouched (git status clean). 9/9 align-fleet.bats offline tests pass; bash -n + shellcheck clean; detectors 16/16 and audit-fleet 18/18 still pass.

T039.description: Fix --apply-vault dead-end when manifests are already rewritten (migration plan empty because it is computed from pre-rewrite keys); add git HEAD recovery of old keys at same line, vault.tsv effective-rows layer shared by preview+apply, dry-run exit 0 only once rewrite committed
T039.result_summary: Fixed --apply-vault dead-end: migration plan was computed from pre-rewrite keys only, so once --apply-manifests rewrote the fleet the plan went empty and --apply-vault printed 'nothing to align' while Vault data still lived at old paths (real incident: dry-run ALIGN:0/CONFORM:21, 21 unmigrated paths analyst/env/* aws/env/* familytree/{env,auth}/* email/{env,bulk}/* pdf-scan/env/*). Added git HEAD recovery: reads each old key at the same file:line (in-place rewrite preserves line numbers), uses git ls-files --full-name for symlink-safe relpath (fixes /var vs /private/var prefix-strip failure), compares against planner OLD column (raw value, not canonical NEW), emits into vault.tsv consumed by both preview and apply loops. Dry-run now exits 1 while recovery rows are pending (work remains), 0 once the rewrite is committed (HEAD==worktree, no rows). Validated: sandbox git repo committed OLD keys -> apply-manifests -> stub vault CLI recorded exact kv get/put/mv ops recovered from HEAD; real-fleet dry-run shows 21 recovered ops, exit 1. 11/11 align-fleet.bats pass (2 new recovery tests incl. exit-code semantics), bash -n + shellcheck clean, detectors 16/16 audit-fleet 18/18 inventory 8/8 still pass.
